title: A Late Night Chat with a Parakeet

q.en: Who is the narrator of this story?
q.zh: 这个故事的叙述者是谁？

options.zh: 迈达斯国王

options.en: A wise old wizard who wrote the diary before Hattie was even born
options.zh: 一位睿智的老巫师，在哈蒂出生前就写下了这本日记
鹦鹉弗雷德
哈蒂·麦克格劳德，一名三年级女生

explain.en: The diary begins: My name is Hattie MacGruder. I am queen and absolute leader of my third grade class.
explain.zh: 日记开头写道：我叫哈蒂·麦克格劳德。我是三年级班的女王和绝对领袖。

q.en: What surprise did Hattie's mother give her?
q.zh: 哈蒂的妈妈给了她什么惊喜？

options.en: A new Britney Spears CD that her mother bought at the mall that afternoon
options.zh: 一张新的布兰妮·斯皮尔斯唱片，是她妈妈那天下午在商场买的

options.en: A parakeet that had belonged to her great-aunt
options.zh: 一只曾经属于她姑祖母的鹦鹉
一只小猫
一次看电影的机会

explain.en: The surprise was a parakeet, her great-aunt's parakeet, given to her mother by her great-uncle.
explain.zh: 惊喜是一只鹦鹉——她姑祖母的鹦鹉，由姑祖父送给了她的妈妈。

q.en: How is this story mainly told?
q.zh: 这个故事主要以什么形式讲述？

options.en: As a newspaper article that was published in the school paper last week
options.zh: 以一篇新闻报道形式，上周刊登在学校校报上
以一份科学报告形式
以一张食谱清单形式
以哈蒂日记中的篇章形式

explain.en: Hattie says the proof is in my diary and lets the reader read it exactly as she wrote it.
explain.zh: 哈蒂说证据就在她的日记里，并让读者按她写下的原样阅读。

q.en: Why does Hattie call Sybil and Sarah liars?
q.zh: 哈蒂为什么称西比尔和莎拉是「骗子」？

options.zh: 因为她们偷了她的日记
因为她们喜欢布兰妮·斯皮尔斯

options.en: Because they said the parakeet never really talked
options.zh: 因为她们说那只鹦鹉根本没有真的说过话

options.en: Because they ate all the chili cheese fries and then hid the empty box under Hattie's bed
options.zh: 因为她们吃光了辣味芝士薯条，然后把空盒子藏在哈蒂的床底下

explain.en: Hattie writes that Sybil and Sarah said there never was a talking parakeet and that parakeets don't talk.
explain.zh: 哈蒂写道，西比尔和莎拉说从来没有会说话的鹦鹉，还说鹦鹉不会说话。

q.en: What name did the parakeet say he preferred?
q.zh: 鹦鹉说他自己更喜欢被叫做什么名字？

options.en: Britney which was the name of her favorite singer that the parakeet loved to hear
options.zh: 布兰妮，那是她最爱的歌手的名字，鹦鹉最喜欢听她唱歌
戴维

options.en: Fred, though his great-aunt called him Freddie
options.zh: 弗雷德，尽管姑祖母叫他弗雷迪
哈蒂

explain.en: Fred said: my great-aunt called him Freddie, but he much preferred Fred.
explain.zh: 弗雷德说：姑祖母叫他弗雷迪，但他更喜欢弗雷德。

q.en: Why does Hattie keep a diary about the parakeet?
q.zh: 哈蒂为什么要写关于鹦鹉的日记？

options.en: To list her favorite songs so she could sing them to Fred every morning
options.zh: 为了列出她最爱的歌曲，这样她每天早晨就能唱给弗雷德听
为了练习拼写

options.en: To prove the truth about the talking parakeet
options.zh: 为了证明会说话的鹦鹉确有其事
为了写学校作文

explain.en: Hattie says My diary proves it! because others did not believe her.
explain.zh: 哈蒂说「我的日记证明了这一切！」，因为别人都不相信她。

q.en: What happened to Fred the next morning?
q.zh: 第二天早上，弗雷德怎么了？

options.zh: 他学会了阅读

options.en: He ate the whole pillow and left white feathers all over the bedroom floor
options.zh: 他把整只枕头吃了，还在卧室地板上留下一地白色羽毛

options.en: He was gone; the cage was empty
options.zh: 他不见了；笼子是空的
他变成了金子

explain.en: Hattie writes: When I woke up, he was gone! The cage was still there, but it was empty.
explain.zh: 哈蒂写道：我醒来时，他不见了！笼子还在，但空了。

q.en: What kind of story is 'A Late Night Chat with a Parakeet'?
q.zh: 《深夜与鹦鹉的聊天》是一个怎样的故事？

options.en: A book of real science facts that explains how parakeets learn to talk
options.zh: 一本真实的科学事实书，讲解鹦鹉如何学会说话
一部巴西历史
关于迈达斯国王的神话

options.en: A humorous fiction told through a diary
options.zh: 以日记形式讲述的幽默小说

explain.en: The cover shows it is a Level P Leveled Book written by Stephen Cosgrove, a work of fiction.
explain.zh: 封面显示这是斯蒂芬·科斯格罗夫所写的 P 级分级读物，属于虚构作品。

q.en: According to Hattie, what did Fred the parakeet like to eat?
q.zh: 据哈蒂说，鹦鹉弗雷德喜欢吃什么？

options.en: Jelly or chili cheese fries, not just seeds
options.zh: 果冻或辣味芝士薯条，而不只是种子
新鲜的鱼

options.en: Only dry bird seeds because Hattie forgot to buy any other food at the store
options.zh: 只有干鸟食，因为哈蒂在商店里忘了买别的食物
绿叶

explain.en: Hattie says he would rather eat jelly or chili cheese fries and loves Britney Spears.
explain.zh: 哈蒂说，它更想吃果冻或辣味芝士薯条，而且喜欢布兰妮·斯皮尔斯。

q.en: How does the story end regarding Fred?
q.zh: 关于弗雷德，故事是如何结尾的？

options.zh: 他成了班级的宠物

options.en: He learned to drive a car after reading a book about cars in Hattie's classroom
options.zh: 他学会了开车，在读完哈蒂教室里一本关于汽车的书之后

options.en: He may have flown south with the wild ducks
options.zh: 他可能已经和野鸭一起飞往南方
他变成了一座雕像

explain.en: Hattie guesses Fred talked about traveling with the ducks and probably headed south with them.
explain.zh: 哈蒂猜测，弗雷德曾说起要和鸭子一起旅行，大概是跟着一群野鸭往南飞走了。

prompt.en: Hattie believes her parakeet really talked. Write a few sentences telling whether you think Fred was real or imagined, and give one reason from the story.
prompt.zh: 哈蒂相信她的鹦鹉真的说过话。写几句话，说明你认为弗雷德是真实的还是想象出来的，并从故事中给出一个理由。

en: Use a detail from Hattie's diary to support it.
zh: 用哈蒂日记中的一个细节来支持它。
